dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Of course! You may not know this, but Ms. Sulaykha is a real genius. She was invited to study at Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: She rejected those block-headed adults, though. She said, and I quote, "Learning is no fun compared to making money."

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Ms. Sulaykha also told me that the biggest secret to building wealth is to "stay away from the Kalimi Exchange."

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: A genius boss with a caring heart. I should have enough to last me for life!
